name: Counter-Strike 2
description: Counter-Strike 2 dedicated server with a live console. Competitive, casual, wingman or deathmatch.

ports.name: game
ports.description: Game traffic; players connect to host:port

variables.label: Server name
variables.description: Shown in the server browser. No quotes, slashes, $, & or backticks.

variables.label: Game Server Login Token
variables.description: From https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers (app 730). Without one the server is reachable on LAN only.

variables.label: Join password
variables.description: Leave blank for a public server. Letters, digits, - and _.

variables.label: Skip the update on start
variables.description: Start faster with the installed server instead of checking Steam for an update. Players cannot join an outdated server.

variables.label: Verify game files on start
variables.description: Have SteamCMD check every installed file. Very slow; turn it on to repair a broken install.

notes:
Runs on the [DeployKit CS2 image](https://github.com/deploykithq/deploykit-game-images/tree/master/images/cs2).

- **The first start downloads about 60 GB** from Steam and can take a long time; make sure the host has the disk space. The game updates itself on every restart.
- **Internet play needs a Game Server Login Token** (Steam app 730). Without one the server only accepts LAN connections.
- Put your own cvars in `cfg/server.cfg`, and per-mode ones in `cfg/gamemode_<mode>_server.cfg`: every `.cfg` in `cfg/` is linked into the game. Backups cover `cfg/` only, never the game files.
- The console talks to the server over RCON inside the container, with a password generated at every start that never leaves it.
